Subject: LuminaPay: evidence for retention & BYOK for Redwood Dedicated

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking this. LuminaPay is finalizing our security review for the Dedicated deployment and we have three asks we need evidence or a decision on by next Tuesday (2027-09-14):

1) Retention window evidence — we require an export of audit logs for the last 12 months (indexed by tenant id) and a short summary describing retention policies and TTL semantics.
2) BYOK/KMS — confirmation on whether Redwood can support customer-managed keys for the Dedicated cluster (KMIP/KMS integration) and, if not yet supported, a timeline and mitigation.
3) SSO / Session logs — we need SSO auth events (success/fail) to be exportable for forensics in CSV/JSON.

I've attached the LuminaPay security questionnaire and flagged where we need concrete artifacts (evidence snippets preferred). Our procurement team is pressing on the PO and these are gating items for the legal signoff.

Can we get a triage plan and owners by Monday EOD PST?

Appreciate it —
Peter

Attachment: luminapay_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf (doc)

Hannah / Grace — I dug into the Dedicated deployment constraints and have a proposed technical split: 

1) Audit export (short path): we can produce an export of audit logs + auth events filtered by tenant id. Format: compressed CSV or newline-delimited JSON. Estimated work: 3 dev-days to produce an internal export tool + 2 QA days to validate schemas and PII redaction (total ~1 calendar week). I attached an example CSV template.

2) BYOK (long path): full customer-managed KMS for Dedicated requires changes across provisioning and key-wrapping layers. Rough estimate: 8-10 weeks for end-to-end support (includes KMS integration, documented procedures, HSM/KMIP connectors, and compliance review). Short-term mitigation: support an encrypted-escrow workflow — customer uploads keys to our escrow in a sealed flow (no persistent customer private key in our control) while we scope proper BYOK. That would still need legal signoff.

Product asks we need clarity on from LuminaPay:
- Desired KMS provider(s) and whether they require HSM-backed keys.
- Retention granularity: per-tenant TTL vs global buckets.
- Whether they require log immutability proofs or just time-series exports.

Attachment: audit_export_template.csv

I'll volunteer Marcus to lead the export path; need Grace to sign off on redaction policy and Hannah to confirm business acceptance for the escrow mitigation if BYOK cannot be delivered in time.

—Marcus
